title: Transactions
explain: A transaction groups several statements so they all succeed or none do. `BEGIN` starts one, `COMMIT` saves it and `ROLLBACK` undoes it. This is what keeps a money transfer from taking from one account without adding to the other.
exercise: Run a transfer that you `ROLLBACK` halfway through and confirm the balances did not change.
tip: Keep transactions short. A long open transaction holds locks and blocks other users.
